verdict.rationale: Vanta markets a built-in Vanta AI Agent that works across the platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues. The pricing page lists agentic search and question-asking across policies, controls, frameworks, tests, and documents, and there is a dedicated TPRM Agent and agentic questionnaire workflows. All of this comes from marketing pages, with no in-depth documentation of how tasks are delegated. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on delegating tasks to the agent (scope, approval flow, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent completes delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
